prompt: Ka yi tunanin kantin kayan miya na nan gaba inda robobin AI ke taimakawa masu siyayya, amma suna da tunanin kansu. Ta yaya wannan ke shafar kwarewar sayayya?
prompt_en: Imagine a futuristic grocery store where AI-driven robots assist shoppers, but they have a mind of their own. How does this affect the shopping experience?

prompt: Juya rana ta yau da kullun na gudanar da ayyuka zuwa ga almara, tare da kowane tasha yana gabatar da ƙalubale na musamman (misali, maido da abubuwan da ba kasafai ba, warware wasanin gwada ilimi, da sauransu).
prompt_en: Turn a mundane day of running errands into an epic quest, with each stop presenting a unique challenge (e.g., retrieving rare ingredients, solving puzzles, etc.).

prompt: Ƙungiyar masu bincike sun haɓaka fasaha don tsalle tsakanin girma, amma kowane girma yana da haɗari fiye da na ƙarshe. Me ya sa su ci gaba?
prompt_en: A group of explorers has developed technology to jump between dimensions, but each dimension is subtly more dangerous than the last. What keeps them going?

prompt: Otal a asirce yana bayyana a wurare daban-daban na duniya, amma da dare kawai. Da gari ya waye, sai ya bace. Menene sirrinsa?
prompt_en: A hotel mysteriously appears in different locations around the world, but only at night. Once morning comes, it vanishes. What’s its secret?

prompt: Rubuta imel zuwa ga farfesan ku na neman tsawaita aiki. Bayyana halin da ake ciki da kuma samar da madaidaicin lokaci don lokacin da za ku iya kammala aikin.
prompt_en: Write an email to your professor requesting an extension for an assignment. Explain your situation and provide a reasonable timeline for when you can complete the work.

prompt: Wani jami'in bincike ya tashi ba tare da tunawa da sa'o'i 48 da suka gabata ba, sai dai ya gano cewa su ne babban wanda ake zargi da aikata babban laifi. Ta yaya suke tabbatar da rashin laifi?
prompt_en: A detective wakes up with no memory of the last 48 hours, only to find that they’re the prime suspect in a major crime. How do they prove their innocence?

prompt: Ka yi tunanin ajin yoga da ke faruwa a cikin ɗakin karatu mai ban sha'awa inda nauyi ke canzawa, lanƙwasa lokaci, da fa'ida yana ɗaukar tasirin sihiri.
prompt_en: Imagine a yoga class that takes place in an enchanted studio where gravity shifts, time bends, and poses take on magical effects.

prompt: Duk lokacin da kuka hau bas don aiki, kuna samun nau'ikan nau'ikan tafiya iri ɗaya a cikin sararin samaniya. Wadanne alamu ko canje-canje kuka fara gani?
prompt_en: Every time you take the bus to work, you experience a different version of the same commute in a parallel universe. What patterns or changes do you begin to notice?

prompt: Rubuta imel zuwa aboki na kud da kud ko memba na iyali yana raba labarai masu kayatarwa. Faɗa musu cikakkun bayanai da yadda kuke ji game da shi.
prompt_en: Write an email to a close friend or family member sharing exciting news. Tell them the details and how you’re feeling about it.

prompt: Rubuta imel na gode wa dan uwa ko aboki don kyauta da suka ba ku. Ka bayyana ainihin dalilin da ya sa kake godiya da kyautar da kuma yadda kake shirin amfani da ita.
prompt_en: Write an email thanking a family member or friend for a gift they gave you. Be specific about why you appreciate the gift and how you plan to use it.

prompt: Rubuta saƙon imel zuwa ofishin shiga na jami'a yana neman bayani game da takamaiman shiri. Tambayi game da tsarin aikace-aikacen, kwanakin ƙarshe, da sauransu.
prompt_en: Write an email to the admissions office of a university requesting information about a specific program. Ask about the application process, deadlines, etc.

prompt: Rubuta saƙon imel zuwa sashen sabis na abokin ciniki na kamfani don magance ƙarancin gogewar da kuka samu game da sabis ɗin su. Bayyana matsalar kuma ba da shawarar yadda kuke son warware ta.
prompt_en: Write an email to a company’s customer service department to address a poor experience you had with their service. Explain the problem and suggest how you would like it resolved.

prompt: Rubuta imel zuwa wakilin sabis na abokin ciniki yana tambaya game da samuwa da ƙayyadaddun samfurin da kuke sha'awar siya.
prompt_en: Write an email to a customer service representative inquiring about the availability and specifications of a product you are interested in purchasing.

prompt: Manya da yawa har yanzu ba su da ainihin ƙwarewar dijital a duniyar yau. Menene dalilan wannan, kuma menene za a iya yi don inganta ilimin dijital?
prompt_en: Many adults still do not have basic digital skills in today's world. What are the reasons behind this, and what can be done to improve digital literacy?

prompt: Ci gaban fasaha ya canza yadda mutane ke sadarwa. Menene fa'idodi da rashin amfanin wannan ci gaban?
prompt_en: Technological advancements have changed how people communicate. What are the advantages and disadvantages of this development?

prompt: Ka yi tunanin zama a cikin gidan da zai iya tsaftace kansa amma yana da 'ra'ayin' game da yadda tsabta ya kamata ya kasance. Wadanne matsaloli ne suka taso?
prompt_en: Imagine living in a house that can clean itself but develops its own 'opinions' on what cleanliness should look like. What problems arise?

prompt: Tawagar masu bincike sun gano wata boyayyiyar wayewa wacce duniyar waje ba ta taba ta ba tsawon shekaru aru-aru. Ta yaya suke mu'amala da wannan al'umma?
prompt_en: A team of explorers discovers a hidden civilization that has been untouched by the outside world for centuries. How do they interact with this society?

prompt: Rubuta tattaunawa tsakanin mai rai da fatalwa wanda ke ba da shawarar rayuwa mara tsammani.
prompt_en: Write a dialogue between a living person and a ghost who offers unexpected life advice.

prompt: Bayyana tsarin aikin nesa, amma maimakon yin aiki daga gida, halin yana aiki daga wurare daban-daban (kamar tsibirai masu iyo ko gandun daji masu sihiri).
prompt_en: Describe a remote work routine, but instead of working from home, the character is working from different fantastical locations (like floating islands or enchanted forests).

prompt: A cikin duniyar da za a iya sace abubuwan tunawa, kwatanta rayuwar barawon ƙwaƙwalwar ajiya wanda ya fara rasa gano ainihin su.
prompt_en: In a world where memories can be stolen, describe the life of a memory thief who begins to lose track of their own identity.

prompt: Ka yi tunanin cewa duk lokacin da ka yi aiki, ana kai ka zuwa wata gaskiya ta dabam inda ƙarfin jikinka ya shafi duniyar da ke kewaye da kai. Bayyana zaman motsa jiki guda ɗaya.
prompt_en: Imagine that every time you work out, you are transported to an alternate reality where your physical strength affects the world around you. Describe one workout session.

prompt: An sake gano wata masarauta da ake tunanin bata a tarihi, amma mutanenta ba su yi shekaru aru-aru ba. Me ya same su?
prompt_en: A kingdom thought to be lost in history is rediscovered, but its people haven’t aged in centuries. What happened to them?

prompt: Rubuta imel ga farfesa yana tambaya game da yuwuwar damar bincike. Bayyana abubuwan da kuke so kuma ku bayyana dalilin da yasa kuke son yin aiki tare da su.
prompt_en: Write an email to a professor inquiring about potential research opportunities. Highlight your interests and explain why you’d like to work with them.

prompt: Rubuta game da mataimaki na sirri na AI wanda ya fara fassara ayyuka da ƙirƙira kuma yana ɗaukar ayyuka waɗanda duka biyu masu taimako ne kuma waɗanda ba za a iya faɗi ba.
prompt_en: Write about an AI personal assistant that starts to interpret tasks creatively and takes actions that are both helpful and wildly unpredictable.

prompt: Wasu na ganin yakamata iyaye su kasance masu alhakin tarbiyyar yara, yayin da wasu ke ganin yakamata gwamnati ta taka rawa. Ku tattauna duka ra'ayoyi kuma ku ba da ra'ayin ku.
prompt_en: Some believe parents should be solely responsible for raising children, while others think the government should play a role. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

prompt: Rubuta imel zuwa ga abokan karatunku masu daidaita aikin rukuni. Sanya ayyuka, saita kwanakin ƙarshe, da ba da shawarar lokacin taro don tattauna ci gaba.
prompt_en: Compose an email to your classmates coordinating a group project. Assign tasks, set deadlines, and suggest a meeting time to discuss progress.

prompt: Rubuta saƙon imel mai zuwa ga abokin ciniki mai yuwuwa wanda ya nuna sha'awar samfurin ku. Tunatar da su fa'idodin kuma bayar da amsa kowace tambaya.
prompt_en: Write a follow-up email to a potential client who expressed interest in your product. Remind them of the benefits and offer to answer any questions.

prompt: Ka yi tunanin wani masarauta inda motsin rai ke sarrafa yanayi. Bayyana rana a cikin rayuwar ɗan ƙasa da ke zaune a can.
prompt_en: Imagine a kingdom where emotions control the weather. Describe a day in the life of a citizen living there.

prompt: Ƙirƙirar tattaunawa tsakanin ɗan sama jannati da baƙo wanda ke sadarwa ta amfani da launuka maimakon kalmomi.
prompt_en: Create a conversation between an astronaut and an alien who communicates using colors instead of words.

prompt: Wasu sun yi imanin samun daidaiton rayuwar aiki ya fi wahala a yau fiye da na baya. Har yaushe kuka yarda ko kin yarda da wannan magana?
prompt_en: Some believe achieving work-life balance is more difficult today than in the past. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement?

prompt: Wasu gungun 'yan fashin teku na sararin sama suna zirga-zirgar jiragen ruwa a cikin tsibirai masu iyo da kuma biranen sararin sama don neman taska ta almara da ke boye a cikin gajimare.
prompt_en: A band of sky pirates navigates airships through floating islands and sky cities in search of a legendary treasure hidden in the clouds.

prompt: Ana gudanar da wani taro tsakanin nau'ikan baƙo daban-daban don samar da yarjejeniyar zaman lafiya ta duniya. Ta yaya suke shawo kan matsalolin harshe da al'adu?
prompt_en: A conference is held between various alien species to form a universal peace treaty. How do they overcome language and cultural barriers?

prompt: Wani sabon ƙa'ida yana da'awar siffanta 'cikakkiyar ranar aiki' bisa ɗabi'a da abubuwan zaɓin mutum. Rubuta game da wanda ya gwada shi, kawai don gano yana da tsanani fiye da yadda suke tsammani.
prompt_en: A new app claims to simulate the ‘perfect workday’ based on an individual’s habits and preferences. Write about someone who tries it, only to discover it's far more intense than they expected.

prompt: Yanzu kun fara sabon aiki kuma kuna son gabatar da kanku ga membobin ƙungiyar ku. Rubuta imel na yau da kullun don gabatar da kanku da bayyana jin daɗin ku game da yin aiki tare.
prompt_en: You’ve just started a new job and want to introduce yourself to your team members. Write a formal email introducing yourself and expressing your excitement about working together.

prompt: Kasuwancin kan layi ya zama sananne a cikin 'yan shekarun nan. Menene dalilan wannan yanayin, kuma wane tasiri yake da shi ga kasuwancin gida?
prompt_en: Online shopping has become increasingly popular in recent years. What are the reasons for this trend, and what impact does it have on local businesses?

prompt: Rubuta game da wanda ya yi yarjejeniya da sihiri don tsayawa kan manufofin lafiyar su. Kowace rana sun tsallake wani aiki, suna fuskantar wani sakamako mai ban mamaki amma mara daɗi.
prompt_en: Write about someone who makes a deal with a magical being to stick to their health goals. Each day they skip a task, they face a quirky but inconvenient consequence.

prompt: Rubuta imel zuwa ga abokin ciniki mai ƙima yana gode musu don ci gaba da kasuwancin su, kuma sanar da su game da haɓaka ko tayi na musamman.
prompt_en: Compose an email to a valued customer thanking them for their continued business, and inform them about a special promotion or offer.

prompt: Rubuta tattaunawa tsakanin mai bincike da mai aikata laifuka wadanda abokanan yara ne a asirce.
prompt_en: Write a dialogue between a detective and a criminal mastermind who are secretly childhood friends.

prompt: Ƙirƙiri labari a kusa da wani tsohon kayan tarihi wanda, lokacin da aka taɓa shi, yana nuna wa mai riƙe da hangen nesa na makomarsu, amma na daƙiƙa 10 kawai.
prompt_en: Create a narrative around an ancient artifact that, when touched, shows the holder a glimpse of their future, but only for 10 seconds.

prompt: A cikin gaba mai sarrafawa ta AI, yanke shawara ta ƙarshe da aka ba wa ɗan adam damar yin ita ce ƙwaƙwalwar da suke son adanawa har abada.
prompt_en: In a future controlled by AI, the last decision humans are allowed to make is which memory they want to preserve for eternity.

prompt: Shirya imel mai tabbatar da sabon mai biyan kuɗi zuwa wasiƙar kamfanin ku. Na gode musu don biyan kuɗi, gaya musu abin da za su jira, kuma sun haɗa da kiran aiki.
prompt_en: Compose an email confirming a new subscriber to your company’s newsletter. Thank them for subscribing, tell them what to expect, and include a call to action.

prompt: Ka yi tunanin ofishin da kowane ma'aikaci ke wakiltar motsin rai daban-daban (misali, farin ciki, fushi, hassada). Ta yaya suke kewaya ayyuka na yau da kullun da tarurruka?
prompt_en: Imagine an office where every employee represents a different emotion (e.g., joy, anger, envy). How do they navigate daily tasks and meetings?

prompt: Ƙirƙirar duniyar da kawai tushen ruwa shi ne wani yanki na sufanci wanda ke motsawa kowane wata, yana haifar da ƙaura na dukan mazauna.
prompt_en: Create a world where the only source of water is a mystical oasis that moves every month, leading to constant migration of all inhabitants.

prompt: A lahira ana yin shari’ar rayuka ne bisa tunanin alherin da suka bari. Wani hali ya gane cewa kuɗin kuɗi ya ƙare.
prompt_en: In the afterlife, souls are judged based on the memories of kindness they left behind. A character realizes they are running out of currency.

prompt: Rubuta imel don bin diddigin hirar aiki da kuka yi makonni biyu da suka gabata. Bayyana ci gaba da sha'awar ku ga matsayi, gode wa mai tambayoyin don lokacinsu, kuma ku nemi sabuntawa.
prompt_en: Write an email to follow up on a job interview you had two weeks ago. Express your continued interest in the position, thank the interviewer for their time, and ask for updates.

prompt: Rubuta saƙon imel zuwa ga farfesan ku yana neman afuwar rashin aji saboda yanayin da ba a zata ba. Tambayi idan akwai wani abu da kuke buƙatar cim ma.
prompt_en: Write an email to your professor apologizing for missing a class due to unforeseen circumstances. Ask if there is any material you need to catch up on.

prompt: Mai yin tsana ya ƙirƙiri ƴan tsana masu kama da rai, amma bayan bacewarsa na ban mamaki, tsana ta fara aiki kamar suna raye, kowanne da mugun nufi.
prompt_en: A dollmaker creates lifelike dolls, but after his mysterious disappearance, the dolls begin to act as if they are alive, each with sinister intentions.

prompt: Yi bayanin maraice na yau da kullun da aka yi amfani da shi tare da dabbar sihiri wanda ke da ikon canza siffarsa don dacewa da yanayin mai shi.
prompt_en: Describe a routine evening spent with a magical pet that has the ability to change its form to match the owner's mood.

prompt: Mutum ya fara dandana mafarkinsa a rayuwa ta ainihi. A duk lokacin da suka farka, wani yanki na duniyar mafarki yana biye da su cikin gaskiya.
prompt_en: A person begins to experience their nightmares in real life. Every time they wake up, another piece of the nightmare world follows them into reality.

prompt: Shirya saƙon imel na yau da kullun wanda ke gayyatar abokai zuwa liyafa da kuke shiryawa. Haɗa cikakkun bayanai game da kwanan wata, lokaci, wuri, da kowane ayyuka na musamman.
prompt_en: Compose an informal email inviting friends to a party you’re hosting. Include details about the date, time, location, and any special activities.

prompt: A cikin jeji mai cike da hadari mai yashi da boyayyun halittu, masu kasada suna gasa a gasar tseren shekara-shekara don samun kyauta mai yawa.
prompt_en: In a desert filled with dangerous sandstorms and hidden creatures, adventurers compete in an annual race for a rare prize.

prompt: Kun lura da cajin da ba daidai ba akan lissafin ku na wata-wata. Rubuta saƙon imel zuwa sashen lissafin kuɗi yana bayyana batun da neman gyara.
prompt_en: You’ve noticed an incorrect charge on your monthly bill. Write an email to the billing department explaining the issue and asking for a correction.

prompt: Wasu sun yi imanin cewa kafofin watsa labarun na da tasiri mai kyau ga al'umma, yayin da wasu ke tunanin yana da mummunan tasiri. Ku tattauna duka ra'ayoyi kuma ku ba da ra'ayin ku.
prompt_en: Some believe social media has a positive influence on society, while others think it has a negative impact. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

prompt: Ka yi tunanin duniyar da ake sayar da motsin rai. Ta yaya wannan zai canza mu'amala da al'umma?
prompt_en: Imagine a world where emotions are bottled and sold. How would this change human interactions and society?

prompt: Ma'aikatan jirgin sun makale a wani tsibiri mai ban mamaki wanda koyaushe yana jujjuya yanayin yanayinsa kuma yana ɓoye tsoffin sirrin.
prompt_en: A crew gets stranded on a mysterious island that constantly shifts its landscape and hides ancient secrets.

prompt: Ka yi tunanin kana da babban iko wanda zai baka damar dakatar da lokaci na mintuna 10 kowane awa. Ta yaya kuke shigar da wannan cikin ayyukanku na yau da kullun?
prompt_en: Imagine you have a superpower that allows you to pause time for 10 minutes every hour. How do you incorporate this into your daily routine?

prompt: A cikin ofishin sihiri, ma'aikata suna amfani da potions don haɓaka aikin su don ayyuka daban-daban. Menene zai faru idan wani ya ɗauki maganin da bai dace ba don aikin da bai dace ba?
prompt_en: In a magical office, employees use potions to boost their productivity for different tasks. What happens when someone takes the wrong potion for the wrong task?

prompt: Rubuta game da mutumin da ba da sani ba ya sanya hannu kan kwangila tare da matsafi mai ƙarfi kuma yanzu dole ne ya cika wani aiki na kusa da ba zai yuwu ba.
prompt_en: Write about a person who unknowingly signs a contract with a powerful sorcerer and now must fulfill a near-impossible task.

prompt: Ka kwatanta balaguro zuwa zurfin teku, inda suka sami wani abin da ba zato ba tsammani—wani tsohon birni da halittun da ba a san su ba suke tsaro.
prompt_en: Describe an expedition to the deepest part of the ocean, where they find something unexpected—an ancient city guarded by unknown creatures.

prompt: Rubuta imel mai sanyi ga mai yuwuwar abokin ciniki yana gabatar da kamfanin ku kuma yana ba da sabis ɗin ku. Hana mahimman ƙarfin ku kuma bayyana yadda zaku iya taimakawa kasuwancin su.
prompt_en: Write a cold email to a potential client introducing your company and offering your services. Highlight your key strengths and explain how you can help their business.

prompt: Kwatanta rana a Duniya inda nauyi ke juyawa ba zato ba tsammani na 'yan sa'o'i. Yaya mutane da dabbobi suke yi?
prompt_en: Describe a day on Earth where gravity suddenly reverses for a few hours. How do people and animals react?

prompt: Sauyin yanayi yana yin tasiri sosai a duniyarmu. Me kuke ganin su ne manyan musabbabin sauyin yanayi, kuma mene ne illarsa ga muhalli?
prompt_en: Climate change is having a significant impact on our planet. What do you think are the main causes of climate change, and what are its potential effects on the environment?

prompt: Ka yi tunanin yanayi yana rera waƙa a ƙasa kafin dare ya faɗi. Wadanne kalmomi da hoto za ta yi amfani da su?
prompt_en: Imagine nature singing a lullaby to the earth before the night falls. What words and imagery would it use?

prompt: Rubuta imel ɗin tallace-tallace zuwa abokin ciniki na yanzu yana ba da samfuran alaƙa waɗanda za su iya sha'awar dangane da sayayya na baya. Bayyana dalilin da yasa waɗannan samfuran suka dace da siyan su.
prompt_en: Write a sales email to an existing customer offering related products they might be interested in based on previous purchases. Highlight why these products complement their purchase.

prompt: Kiba na zama babbar matsala a kasashe da dama. Menene musabbabin wannan batu, kuma wadanne matakai za a dauka don magance shi?
prompt_en: Obesity is becoming a serious problem in many countries. What are the causes of this issue, and what measures could be taken to address it?

prompt: Rubuta game da duniyar da wani ci-gaba nau'i ne ya kera shi amma an yi watsi da shi. Menene sababbin mazaunan suka gano game da ainihin manufarsa?
prompt_en: Write about a planet that was engineered by an advanced species but has been abandoned. What do the new inhabitants discover about its true purpose?

prompt: Shirya imel ɗin tallace-tallace yana sanar da ƙaddamar da sabon samfur. Haɗa cikakkun bayanai game da fasalulluka na samfurin, fa'idodin, da duk wani talla na musamman ko rangwame.
prompt_en: Compose a marketing email announcing the launch of a new product. Include details about the product’s features, benefits, and any special promotions or discounts.

prompt: Rubuta imel zuwa ga tsohon ma'aikaci yana neman amfani da su azaman tunani don sabon aikace-aikacen aiki. Cikin ladabi ka nemi izininsu kuma ka gode musu bisa goyon bayan da suka ba su.
prompt_en: Compose an email to a former employer requesting to use them as a reference for a new job application. Politely ask for their permission and thank them for their support.

prompt: Hasashen al'ummar da aka haɗa sihiri da fasaha ba tare da matsala ba. Ta yaya mutane suke amfani da waɗannan iko a rayuwarsu ta yau da kullun?
prompt_en: Envision a society where magic and technology are seamlessly integrated. How do people use these powers in their daily lives?

prompt: A ƙasashe da yawa, matasa suna kokawa don neman aikin yi. Menene musabbabin wannan batu, kuma wace mafita za ku iya ba da shawara?
prompt_en: In many countries, young people struggle to find employment. What are the causes of this issue, and what solutions can you suggest?

prompt: Rubuta waƙa inda kowane yanayi ya zama mutum kuma suna tattaunawa game da zagayowar rayuwa.
prompt_en: Write a poem where each season is personified and they engage in a conversation about the cycle of life.

prompt: Ƙirƙirar shigarwar mujalla daga wani sanannen mai binciken tarihi wanda ya yi tuntuɓe a kan ƙasar da babu taswira.
prompt_en: Create a journal entry from a famous historical explorer who stumbles upon a land that doesn’t exist on any map.

prompt: Yawan jama'a yana zama abin damuwa a birane da yawa. Menene musabbabin yawaitar jama'a, kuma menene illar rayuwar birane?
prompt_en: Overpopulation is becoming a serious concern in many cities. What are the causes of overpopulation, and what are the effects on urban life?

prompt: Ƙirƙirar waƙar da ke ɗaukar mai karatu ta hanyar jerin abubuwan mafarki na gaskiya, haɗa gaskiya da tunani.
prompt_en: Compose a poem that takes the reader through a series of surreal dreamscapes, blending reality and imagination.

prompt: Wani baƙo mai rufe fuska yana ci gaba da bayyana a wuraren aikata laifuka daban-daban amma ba a taɓa samun alaƙa da laifin ba. Wanene su, kuma menene suka sani?
prompt_en: A masked stranger keeps appearing at various crime scenes but never seems to be connected to the crime. Who are they, and what do they know?

prompt: Duk lokacin da za ku yi wanki, safa ya ɓace, amma maimakon ya ɓace, yana tafiya cikin lokaci. Rubuta game da binciken da wannan ke kaiwa zuwa.
prompt_en: Every time you do the laundry, a sock goes missing, but instead of disappearing, it travels through time. Write about the discoveries this leads to.

prompt: Rubuta imel zuwa tsohon farfesa ko mai ba da shawara yana neman shawarar aiki. A taƙaice bayyana halin da kuke ciki kuma ku nemi jagora kan yadda zaku ci gaba.
prompt_en: Compose an email to a former professor or mentor asking for career advice. Briefly explain your current situation and ask for guidance on how to move forward.

prompt: Ka yi tunanin wani hali wanda ke da dabbar mutum-mutumi tare da AI mai ci gaba wanda ya fara haɓaka halinsa da sha'awar sa.
prompt_en: Imagine a character who has a robotic pet with advanced AI that begins to develop its own personality and desires.

prompt: Idan duk launukan duniya sun fara bacewa daya bayan daya fa? Bayyana abin da zai faru idan akwai saura launi ɗaya kawai.
prompt_en: What if all the colors in the world started disappearing one by one? Describe what happens when there's only one color left.

prompt: Ƙirƙirar ƙirƙira ƙirar jerin abubuwan yi da ba a saba gani ba wanda ke juya ayyukan yau da kullun zuwa wasa. Menene dokoki, kuma ta yaya suke motsa ku?
prompt_en: Invent a creative and unusual to-do list format that turns daily chores into a game. What are the rules, and how do they motivate you?

prompt: Rubuta game da sabon baƙon amma gajerun tattaunawa da ke gudana akan jigilar jama'a tsakanin fasinjojin da suka fito daga sassa daban-daban na rayuwa.
prompt_en: Write about the unusual but brief conversations that take place on public transit between passengers who come from very different walks of life.

prompt: Yi rubutu game da gudanar da ayyuka a kasuwa inda masu sayar da kayayyaki ke siyar da abubuwa na yau da kullun da na sihiri, kuma yin caca yana buƙatar ba kuɗi kawai ba amma dabaru masu wayo ko kacici-kacici.
prompt_en: Write about running errands in a marketplace where vendors sell both mundane and magical items, and haggling requires not just money but clever tricks or riddles.

prompt: Samuwar balaguron balaguron ƙasa ya ƙaru sosai. Tattauna fa'idodi da rashin amfani ga masu yawon buɗe ido da ƙasashen da suka karɓi baƙi.
prompt_en: The availability of international travel has increased significantly. Discuss the advantages and disadvantages for tourists and host countries.

prompt: Kuna buƙatar tsara taro tare da abokin aiki don tattauna ci gaban aikin. Rubuta saƙon imel mai ladabi don neman lokacin da ya dace don taron kuma ba da taƙaitaccen shaci.
prompt_en: You need to schedule a meeting with a colleague to discuss the progress of a project. Write a polite email requesting a suitable time for the meeting and provide a brief outline.

prompt: A nan gaba mai nisa, sararin samaniya yana cike da tarkace na wayewar sararin samaniya da aka manta da su. Kwatanta rayuwar mai ɓarna a cikin waɗannan kango.
prompt_en: In the far future, space is littered with the debris of long-forgotten spacefaring civilizations. Describe a scavenger's life among these ruins.

prompt: Rubuta game da wata fasaha (waya, kwamfutar tafi-da-gidanka, da dai sauransu) wanda wani mahaluki ya zama abin ƙyama. Ta yaya take sarrafa mai ita?
prompt_en: Write about a piece of technology (phone, laptop, etc.) that becomes haunted by a malevolent entity. How does it manipulate its owner?

prompt: A cikin 'yan shekarun nan, aikin nesa ya zama ruwan dare gama gari. Tattauna fa'idodi da rashin amfanin aikin nesa.
prompt_en: In recent years, remote work has become more common. Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of remote work.

prompt: Wasu mutane sun yi imanin cewa ya kamata a magance matsalolin muhalli a duniya, yayin da wasu ke tunanin ya kamata a magance su a cikin gida. Tattauna duka ra'ayoyi kuma ku ba da ra'ayin ku.
prompt_en: Some people believe environmental problems should be solved globally, while others think they should be tackled locally. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

prompt: A cikin birni na gaba, tsarin jirgin karkashin kasa yana canzawa koyaushe. Yi rubutu game da tafiyar wani ta yau da kullun ta wannan tsarin mara tabbas.
prompt_en: In a futuristic city, the subway system is an ever-changing maze. Write about someone's routine commute through this unpredictable system.

prompt: Ƙirƙiri labari inda shirya abinci na yau da kullun ya zama kasada na dafa abinci-kowane sinadari ya fito daga ƙasa mai sihiri kuma yana buƙatar kulawa ta musamman.
prompt_en: Create a story where daily meal prepping turns into a culinary adventure—each ingredient comes from a magical land and requires special handling.

prompt: Wasu sun yi imanin koyon kan layi ya fi tasiri fiye da karatun gargajiya, yayin da wasu ke jayayya cewa koyan aji yana da mahimmanci har yanzu. Ku tattauna duka ra'ayoyi kuma ku ba da ra'ayin ku.
prompt_en: Some believe online learning is more effective than traditional learning, while others argue classroom learning is still crucial. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

prompt: Ka yi tunanin wani madadin tarihi inda Leonardo da Vinci ya kammala na'urar lokaci mai aiki. Menene zai faru idan an gano shi a zamanin yau?
prompt_en: Imagine an alternate history where Leonardo da Vinci completed a working time machine. What would happen if it were discovered in modern times?

prompt: Rubuta imel zuwa ga manajan ku yana ba da uzuri don ɓacewar ranar ƙarshe na aikin. Bayyana dalilin jinkirin, da kuma zayyana matakanku don tabbatar da hakan ba zai sake faruwa ba.
prompt_en: Compose an email to your manager apologizing for missing a project deadline. Explain the reason for the delay, and outline your steps to ensure it won’t happen again.

prompt: A cikin birane da yawa, rashin matsuguni yana karuwa. Menene dalilan karuwar wannan, kuma menene za a iya yi don rage matsalar?
prompt_en: In many urban areas, homelessness is on the rise. What are the reasons for this increase, and what can be done to reduce the problem?

prompt: Bayyana tsarin aiki inda kowane aikin gida ya zama ƙaramin wasa, cikakke tare da matakai, lada, da ƙalubalen da ba zato ba tsammani.
prompt_en: Describe a chore system where every household task is turned into a mini-game, complete with levels, rewards, and unexpected challenges.

prompt: Ka yi tunanin wani birni mai bazuwar ƙarƙashin ƙasa wanda tsire-tsire masu ƙarfin halitta ke aiki. Waɗanne ƙalubale ne mazaunanta suke fuskanta?
prompt_en: Imagine a sprawling underground city powered by bioluminescent plants. What challenges do its inhabitants face?

prompt: Rubuta labari game da al'ummar da na'ura ke tantance darajar mutum. Me zai faru idan wani mai ƙarancin ɗabi'a ya ƙalubalanci tsarin?
prompt_en: Write a story about a society where a machine determines a person's moral worth. What happens when someone with a low moral score challenges the system?

prompt: Tashar wayar tafi da gidanka shine mafi yawan nau'ikan sufuri, amma matsala ta sa masu ababen hawa sun makale na ɗan lokaci tsakanin wurare. Bayyana yadda mutane ke magance wannan rashin jin daɗi na yau da kullun.
prompt_en: Teleportation is the most common form of transportation, but a glitch causes commuters to temporarily get stuck between locations. Describe how people handle this daily inconvenience.

prompt: Ƙirƙirar tattaunawa tsakanin AI da mahaliccinsa, inda AI ke tambayar dalilin kasancewarsa.
prompt_en: Craft a conversation between an AI and its creator, where the AI questions the purpose of its existence.

prompt: Rubuta tattaunawa tsakanin sarakuna biyu da ke hada baki don hambarar da wani sarki da ake so, amma tare da karkatar da cewa daya daga cikinsu yana da wata boyayyiyar manufa.
prompt_en: Write a dialogue between two courtiers conspiring to overthrow a beloved monarch, but with a twist that one of them has a hidden agenda.

prompt: Rubuta game da wani wanda ke yin bimbini a wurare da ba a saba gani ba (misali, a saman bene, a ƙarƙashin teku, a cikin dajin mai yawa) don su ci gaba da zama bayan dogon kwana.
prompt_en: Write about someone who practices meditation in the most unusual of places (e.g., atop a skyscraper, under the sea, in a dense forest) to center themselves after a long day.

prompt: Rubuta saƙon imel zuwa mai siyarwa wanda ya isar da samfuran da ba daidai ba ko lalacewa. Yi bayanin batun cikin ladabi, ba da cikakkun bayanai, kuma nemi maidowa ko musanyawa.
prompt_en: Write an email to a vendor who delivered incorrect or damaged products. Politely explain the issue, provide details, and request a refund or replacement.

prompt: Shirya imel don neman dawowa ko musanya samfurin da kuka saya akan layi. Haɗa lambar odar ku da dalilin dawowar.
prompt_en: Compose an email to request a return or exchange for a product you purchased online. Include your order number and reason for the return.

prompt: A nan gaba kadan, ana iya canza hankali zuwa ga jiki daban-daban. Menene zai faru lokacin da wani ya canza zuwa cikin jikin wucin gadi kuma yana so ya koma ainihin siffar su?
prompt_en: In the near future, consciousness can be transferred to different bodies. What happens when someone transfers into an artificial body and wants to return to their original form?

prompt: Bayyana duniyar da wayewar kai ke rayuwa akan tsibirai masu iyo a sararin sama, kuma ana jigilar albarkatun ta hanyar hanyar sadarwa ta manyan balloons.
prompt_en: Describe a world where civilizations live on floating islands in the sky, and resources are transported through a network of giant balloons.

prompt: Ƙirƙirar hali wanda inuwarsa ta zo rayuwa kuma ta zama takwarorinsu na ɓarna.
prompt_en: Create a character whose shadow has come to life and acts as their mischievous counterpart.

prompt: Rubuta saƙon imel don taya aboki ko abokin aiki murnar nasara kwanan nan. Bayyana farin cikin ku a gare su kuma ku ba da kalmomi na ƙarfafawa.
prompt_en: Write an email congratulating a friend or colleague on a recent achievement. Express your happiness for them and offer words of encouragement.

prompt: Wasu suna jayayya cewa gwajin dabba don binciken likita ya zama dole, yayin da wasu ke ganin ya kamata a hana shi. Tattauna duka ra'ayoyi kuma ku ba da ra'ayin ku.
prompt_en: Some argue that animal testing for medical research is necessary, while others believe it should be banned. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

prompt: Ƙirƙirar aikin tsabtace yau da kullun a cikin duniyar da kowace rana ke kawo cikas na sihiri daban-daban, kamar ƙurar ƙura ko ɓarna kayan aikin tsaftacewa.
prompt_en: Invent a daily cleaning routine in a world where every day brings a different magical obstacle, like enchanted dust or mischievous cleaning tools.

prompt: Rubuta ɗan gajeren labari daga mahangar jirgin ruwa mai ɗorewa wanda ke marmarin abokantaka amma ya makale a duniyar da ba kowa.
prompt_en: Write a short story from the perspective of a sentient spaceship that longs for companionship but is stuck on an uninhabited planet.

prompt: Rubuta saƙon imel zuwa ga mai kula da ku don neman amsa kan rahoton da kuka ƙaddamar kwanan nan. Bayyana sha'awar ku don inganta aikinku kuma ku nemi takamaiman shawarwari.
prompt_en: Write an email to your supervisor asking for feedback on a recent report you submitted. Express your interest in improving your work and ask for specific suggestions.

prompt: Yi rubutu game da garin da, ɗaya bayan ɗaya, mutane ke bacewa ba tare da wata alama ba. Wadanda suka rage ba su da tunawa da bacewar.
prompt_en: Write about a town where, one by one, people are vanishing without a trace. Those who remain have no memory of the missing.

prompt: Dodanni sun dade batattu, amma an sake haifuwa daya cikin jikin mutum. Ta yaya wannan ya shafi duniyar sihiri?
prompt_en: Dragons have long been extinct, but one has been reborn into the body of a human. How does this affect the world of magic?

prompt: Rubuta game da wani hali wanda shine na ƙarshe a cikin irin su rayuwa a cikin duniyar da ta ci gaba ba tare da su ba.
prompt_en: Write about a character who is the last of their kind living in a world that has moved on without them.

prompt: Ƙirƙiri labari game da wani yana ƙoƙarin karya mummunar ɗabi'a (kamar jinkirtawa ko yawan ciye-ciye) ta amfani da hanyoyin da ba na al'ada ko na sihiri.
prompt_en: Create a story about someone trying to break a mundane bad habit (like procrastination or excessive snacking) using unconventional or magical methods.

prompt: A wasu ƙasashe, matsayin jinsi na canzawa, yayin da a wasu, ayyukan gargajiya na ci gaba. Kun yarda matsayin jinsi na canzawa? Wane tasiri wannan ke da shi ga al'umma?
prompt_en: In some countries, gender roles are changing, while in others, traditional roles persist. Do you agree gender roles are changing? What impact is this having on society?

prompt: Ƙungiyoyin abokai sun yi tuntuɓe a kan wani tsohon littafi da ke kwatanta al'ada don kiran wani abin bautawa da aka manta. Suna yin shi a matsayin wasa - har sai ya yi aiki.
prompt_en: A group of friends stumbles upon an old book that describes a ritual to summon a forgotten deity. They perform it as a joke—until it works.

prompt: Mutane da yawa suna ƙaura daga yankunan karkara zuwa birane. Tattauna fa'idodi da rashin amfanin wannan yanayin.
prompt_en: More people are moving from rural areas to cities. Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of this trend.

prompt: Rubuta game da ɗan jarida da ke ba da labarin wani babban al'amari na tarihi wanda ba da gangan ya canza sakamakonsa da rahoto ɗaya ba.
prompt_en: Write about a journalist covering a major historical event who accidentally alters its outcome with a single report.

prompt: A sassa da dama na duniya, adadin mutanen da ke karanta littattafai ya ragu sosai. Menene dalilan wannan koma baya, kuma menene illar al'umma?
prompt_en: In many parts of the world, the number of people reading books has decreased significantly. What are the reasons for this decline, and what are the consequences for society?

prompt: Ƙirƙirar jerin haikus waɗanda kowannensu ke wakiltar rarrabuwar ƙwaƙwalwar ajiyar ƙauna da aka manta.
prompt_en: Create a series of haikus that each represent a fragmented memory of a forgotten love.

prompt: Rubuta game da rana ɗaya a cikin rayuwar mutum mai tsari wanda ke tsara kowane minti na kwanakin su. Menene zai faru lokacin da abubuwa suka fara tafiya a kan jadawalin?
prompt_en: Write about a day in the life of a hyper-organized person who plans every minute of their day. What happens when things start to go off-schedule?

prompt: Ƙirƙiri labari game da ɗakin karatu wanda ya ƙunshi kowane littafi da aka taɓa rubuta da kowane littafi da za a iya rubutawa.
prompt_en: Create a story about a library that contains every book ever written and every book that could ever be written.

prompt: Bayyana balaguron yau da kullun a cikin birni mai ban sha'awa mai cike da abubuwan sihiri, inda jigilar jama'a ta haɗa da karusai masu sihiri, halittu masu tashi, ko tashoshi.
prompt_en: Describe a daily commute in a fantasy city filled with magical creatures, where public transportation includes enchanted carriages, flying creatures, or portals.

prompt: Bayyana tsarin yau da kullun na safiya na gaba inda komai ke sarrafa kansa kuma an inganta shi don iyakar yawan aiki. Waɗanne ƙalubale ne ba zato ba tsammani suka taso?
prompt_en: Describe a futuristic morning routine where everything is automated and optimized for maximum productivity. What unexpected challenges arise?

prompt: Ƙirƙirar hanyar buga jarida ta musamman don yin tunani a kan abubuwan da ke faruwa a rana, ta yin amfani da tsokanar da ke mai da hankali kan ƙananan lokutan godiya, ƙirƙira, ko gano kai.
prompt_en: Invent a unique journaling method for reflecting on the day’s events, using prompts that focus on small moments of gratitude, creativity, or self-discovery.

prompt: A cikin manyan biranen da yawa, gurɓataccen iska da ruwa lamari ne mai mahimmanci. Menene musabbabin wadannan matsalolin, kuma wadanne matakai ne za a iya dauka don inganta lamarin?
prompt_en: In many large cities, air and water pollution is a significant issue. What are the causes of these problems, and what measures can be taken to improve the situation?

prompt: Ƙungiyar masana kimiyya sun gano cewa mafarkai hasashe ne a cikin hakikanin gaskiya. Ta yaya wannan zai canza fahimtarmu game da hankali?
prompt_en: A group of scientists discovers that dreams are glimpses into parallel realities. How does this change our understanding of the mind?

prompt: Wasu sun yi imani da fasaha muhimmin bangare ne na al'umma, yayin da wasu ke tunanin abin alatu ne. Tattauna duka ra'ayoyi kuma ku ba da ra'ayin ku.
prompt_en: Some believe art is an essential part of society, while others think it is a luxury. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

prompt: Haɗin gwiwar duniya ya kawo fa'idodi da yawa, amma har ma da mummunan tasiri a kan wasu al'amuran al'umma. Menene abubuwan da ke haifar da dunkulewar duniya, kuma ta yaya ya shafi duniya?
prompt_en: Globalization has brought many benefits, but also negative impacts on certain aspects of society. What are the causes of globalization, and how has it affected the world?

prompt: A cikin duniyar da za a iya sarrafa mafarkai ta hanyar bin takamaiman al'amuran yau da kullun, kwatanta shirye-shiryen mutum don cikakkiyar mafarkinsa.
prompt_en: In a world where dreams can be controlled by following specific routines, describe a person’s preparation for their perfect dream.

prompt: Rubuta saƙon imel na yau da kullun zuwa jami'in gwamnati yana magance matsalar gida da ta shafe ku. Bayyana damuwar ku, samar da hujjoji masu goyan baya, kuma ku ba da shawarar mafita.
prompt_en: Write a formal email to a government official addressing a local issue that concerns you. State your concerns, provide supporting facts, and suggest possible solutions.

prompt: Haɗin duniya yana haifar da asarar asalin al'adu. Har yaushe kuka yarda ko kin yarda? Wadanne matakai za a iya ɗauka don kiyaye al'adun gida?
prompt_en: Globalization is leading to the loss of cultural identity. To what extent do you agree or disagree? What measures can be taken to preserve local cultures?

prompt: Rubuta waƙar da ke ɗaukar kaɗa da sautin birni mai cike da cunkoson jama'a kamar wasan ban dariya.
prompt_en: Write a poem that captures the rhythm and sounds of a bustling city as if it were a symphony.

prompt: Rubuta labari game da gungun manyan jarumai masu ritaya waɗanda suka fito daga ritaya don manufa ɗaya ta ƙarshe.
prompt_en: Write a story about a group of retired superheroes who come out of retirement for one last mission.

prompt: A ƙasashe da yawa, matsakaicin nauyin mutane yana ƙaruwa, yayin da matakan lafiya da na jiki ke raguwa. Menene musabbabi da hanyoyin magance wannan matsala?
prompt_en: In many countries, the average weight of people is increasing, while health and fitness levels are decreasing. What are the causes and possible solutions to this problem?

prompt: Yi bayanin duniya bayan-apocalyptic wacce ta sake gina kanta a cikin yanayin yanayi, amma tare da sirrin sirri waɗanda ke yin barazana ga zaman lafiyarta.
prompt_en: Describe a post-apocalyptic world that has rebuilt itself into a utopia, but with underlying secrets that threaten its peace.

prompt: Ƙirƙiri wani hali wanda ya taɓa zama jarumi amma ya zama miyagu saboda mummunar rashin fahimta.
prompt_en: Create a character who was once a hero but has become a villain due to a tragic misunderstanding.

prompt: Garuruwa da yawa suna saka hannun jari a tsarin zirga-zirgar jama'a don rage cunkoson ababen hawa. Tattauna fa'idodi da rashin amfanin wannan jarin.
prompt_en: Many cities are investing in public transportation systems to reduce traffic congestion. Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of this investment.

prompt: Bayyana abubuwan da suka faru na matafiyi na lokaci wanda bisa kuskure ya makale a cikin sararin samaniya mai kama da juna inda al'amuran tarihi suka ɗauki salo daban-daban.
prompt_en: Describe the adventures of a time traveler who accidentally gets stuck in a parallel universe where historical events have taken a drastically different turn.

prompt: An tsine wa basarake ko gimbiya don su koma dabba kowane dare. Dole ne su nemo hanyar da za su ɗaga la'anar kafin ta cinye su.
prompt_en: A prince or princess has been cursed to turn into a beast every night. They must find a way to lift the curse before it consumes them.

prompt: Wata kofa mai ban mamaki ta bayyana a cikin dajin da ke kaiwa ga yankin fae. Menene matafiya na farko suka samu a wancan gefen?
prompt_en: A mysterious door appears in the forest that leads to the fae realm. What do the first travelers find on the other side?

prompt: A cikin shahararren zane-zane na zane-zane, zane-zane sun fara radawa asiri game da mutanen da suke kallon su. Menene ke bayan wannan bakon al'amari?
prompt_en: In a renowned art gallery, the paintings begin to whisper secrets about people who view them. What is behind this strange phenomenon?

prompt: An ba ku aikin sayayya mai ban mamaki, amma shagunan da aka tura ku ba komai bane illa na yau da kullun-kowannensu yana da sirrin da ke buƙatar tonawa.
prompt_en: You are tasked with a mystery shopping job, but the stores you're sent to are anything but ordinary—each one has a secret that needs to be uncovered.

prompt: Mai bibiyar lafiyar ku ya fara ba ku keɓaɓɓen shawara, kusan shawara na hauka. Ta yaya yake canza aikin ku na yau da kullun, kuma menene ɓoyayyun ajandarsa?
prompt_en: Your fitness tracker starts giving you personalized, almost psychic advice. How does it transform your routine, and what’s its hidden agenda?

prompt: Bayyana labarin wata ƙungiyar gwagwarmaya a lokacin mulkin zalunci a tarihi, da kuma matsalolin ɗabi'a da suke fuskanta don tsira.
prompt_en: Describe the story of a resistance group during an oppressive regime in history, and the moral dilemmas they face to survive.

prompt: Idan mutane sun fara tsufa a baya, suna ƙarami yayin da suke rayuwa mai tsawo fa? Ta yaya hakan zai shafi dangantakarsu da tunanin lokaci?
prompt_en: What if people started aging backwards, getting younger as they live longer? How would this affect their relationships and the concept of time?

prompt: Rubuta imel zuwa ga tsohon farfesa yana neman su rubuta muku wasiƙar shawarwari. Bada cikakkun bayanai game da matsayi kuma tayin don samar da ƙarin bayani.
prompt_en: Compose an email to a former professor asking them to write a recommendation letter for you. Provide details about the position and offer to provide further information.

prompt: Rubuta game da gida inda duk na'urori zasu iya magana. Kowannensu yana da halaye daban-daban kuma suna ba da shawara (ko korafi) yayin da kuke gudanar da ayyukanku na yau da kullun.
prompt_en: Write about a home where all the appliances can talk. They each have distinct personalities and give advice (or complaints) while you do your daily chores.

prompt: A cikin wani karamin gari, sai rana ta bace ba zato ba tsammani kuma kullum tsakar dare ne. Ba wanda zai iya barin garin, kuma baƙon halittu suka fara fitowa daga cikin duhu.
prompt_en: In a small town, the sun suddenly disappears and it’s always midnight. No one can leave the town, and strange creatures begin to emerge from the darkness.
